haikus.haiku:
Grilled meat sizzles bright
Juice drips down with smoky scent
Tender bites delight
Happy #NationalFiletMignonDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Left hand waves soft bright
Moonlit fingers twirl bright joy
Stars applaud in blue
Happy #LeftHand

Bright swift arrows flash
Red moon paints the range softly
Stars salute her aim
#HappyBirthdayAnnieOakley from @ClamBakeSanta

Dark night, a candle
Shadows flicker, whispers grow
Joy drifts in the air
#HappyBirthdayAlfredHitchcock from @ClamBakeSanta
